model_interpretation.claim: Processing up to eight independent options in contiguous lanes should let the compiler SIMD-vectorize the numerous rollback updates without changing each option's terminal-power exponents, rollback order, or arithmetic expression. The previous attempt did not compile because std::min received an enum and an int; this experiment fixes that type mismatch. Full-call measurement is needed to determine whether SIMD throughput outweighs batching and scratch costs.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Pack independent inputs into batches of eight with lane-contiguous state and scratch storage.","Apply OpenMP SIMD directives across lanes in initialization, terminal-payoff evaluation, rollback updates, and output stores while retaining the baseline terminal-power formula and rollback arithmetic/order."]}

model_interpretation.claim: The pricing for each input is independent and has a fixed-size 64-node initialization and rollback, so a static outer-loop partition should reduce the dominant large-call work without synchronization between elements. The dispatch limits workers to the supplied thread budget and requires at least 256 elements per worker, keeping small calls on a direct serial path and avoiding hardcoding the environment's thread count. Candidate performance remains unmeasured.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Extracted the per-element binomial pricing computation into a helper with private stack-local intermediate values.","Added a serial dispatch path unless more than one worker can receive at least 256 elements.","Parallelized the independent outer loop with static scheduling and num_threads(worker_count), where worker_count is bounded by both the supplied budget and available work."]}

items.subject: Mesurer l’intégration du parallélisme externe T1 et du SIMD T4
items.objective: Demander un programme combinant les sources T1 et T4, en partant de la source la plus rapide T1. Mesurer et valider le résultat combiné sur le protocole officiel; ne pas supposer les gains additifs. Le comparer à T1, T4 et au baseline.
